beats.label: The trend
beats.text: Swap scrolling for a **stack** of puzzles, journaling, coloring and **reading.**

beats.label: Myth vs fact
beats.text: Myth: puzzles boost your **whole** brain. Fact: gains mostly stay with the **task** you **practice.**
beats.note: Simons et al., Psych. Sci. Public Interest 2016

beats.label: The upside
beats.text: Engaging hobbies are **linked** to lower risk of **cognitive** **decline.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Brainstacking itself is **untested,** and those links aren't **proof.** A break from scrolling may be the real **win.**
